en.html: Several chairs stood about a table. A mess hall, or perhaps a lounge... But the man in the corner required more attention than the furniture. The uniform he wore so loosely was that of the League forces—◆one should expect enemy soldiers in enemy territory, of course. And here I had encountered one! I took my stance at once, ready for hostility to become action.
en.text:
Several chairs stood about a table.
A mess hall, or perhaps a lounge...

But the man in the corner required more attention than the furniture.
The uniform he wore so loosely was that of the League forces—◆one should expect enemy soldiers in enemy territory, of course. And here I had encountered one!

I took my stance at once, ready for hostility to become action.

en.html:
Even when I resolved to address him, the drunkard’s condition did not change.
He swigged from a bottle of cheap liquor and bawled something or other.

Fast speech, with the <ruby>articulation<rt>articulation</rt></ruby> all gone. With my English, I could understand less than half. Abuse and demands to bring him something seemed to be mixed together...?

For now, I could only leave him alone. Why Lieutenant Colonel Cannon’s top-secret operation had brought such a person along, I did want to know. But first let me acknowledge my good fortune: no fight was required.

Looking about, I found a door in the wall toward the bow.
That way, or back to the corridor.

Kanae"Lieutenant Colonel Cannon meant to requisition the ship alone for the operation. This gentleman objected and forced his way aboard. After all that, they still would not let him take part. So here he is, having his complaint at considerable length."
Kageaki"...Ah. I see."
Sayo"A cruel arrangement by the lieutenant colonel. An airship captain’s love for the ship can hardly be less than that of a captain at sea."
Kanae"Quite so."
Kageaki"From the lieutenant colonel’s point of view, it would be the natural precaution for secrecy. But... then, the thing he keeps demanding—"
Kanae"Liquor. “How am I to get drunk on this watery imitation of beerale? Bring distilled spiritsgin from the homeland.” Those are his words."
Kageaki"..."
Sayo"A request is easily made, certainly."
